problem:
A racing robot has the following characteristics:
(1) The step length can be manually set to 0.1 meters, 0.2 meters, $\cdots$, 1.8 meters, or 1.9 meters:
(2) After the start command, the robot immediately takes the first step of the set length, and each step is completed instantaneously;
(3) When the step length is set to $a$ meters, the robot needs exactly $a$ seconds between each consecutive step.

Then the minimum time required for the robot to run 50 meters (allowing to exceed 50 meters) is

# Finding the Minimum Time for the Racing Robot

## Setting Up the Time Model

When step length is set to $a$ meters:
- **Step 1** occurs at time $0$ (immediately)
- **Step 2** occurs at time $a$
- **Step 3** occurs at time $2a$
- **Step $n$** occurs at time $(n-1)a$

After completing $n$ steps, the robot has traveled $n \cdot a$ meters.

## Constraint and Time Formula

We need $n \cdot a \geq 50$, so the minimum number of steps is $n = \lceil 50/a \rceil$.

The **time** to complete $n$ steps is:
$$T(a) = (n - 1) \cdot a = \left(\left\lceil \frac{50}{a} \right\rceil - 1\right) \cdot a$$

## Evaluating All 19 Possible Step Lengths

| $a$ (m) | $50/a$ | $n = \lceil 50/a \rceil$ | Time $(n-1) \cdot a$ |
|---------|--------|--------------------------|----------------------|
| 0.1 | 500 | 500 | 49.9 |
| 0.2 | 250 | 250 | 49.8 |
| 0.3 | 166.7 | 167 | 49.8 |
| 0.4 | 125 | 125 | 49.6 |
| 0.5 | 100 | 100 | 49.5 |
| 0.6 | 83.3 | 84 | 49.8 |
| 0.7 | 71.4 | 72 | 49.7 |
| 0.8 | 62.5 | 63 | 49.6 |
| 0.9 | 55.6 | 56 | 49.5 |
| 1.0 | 50 | 50 | 49.0 |
| 1.1 | 45.5 | 46 | 49.5 |
| 1.2 | 41.7 | 42 | 49.2 |
| 1.3 | 38.5 | 39 | 49.4 |
| 1.4 | 35.7 | 36 | 49.0 |
| 1.5 | 33.3 | 34 | 49.5 |
| 1.6 | 31.25 | 32 | 49.6 |
| 1.7 | 29.4 | 30 | 49.3 |
| **1.8** | **27.78** | **28** | **48.6** |
| 1.9 | 26.3 | 27 | 49.4 |

## Verification for $a = 1.8$ m

- Number of steps: $\lceil 50/1.8 \rceil = \lceil 27.7\overline{7} \rceil = 28$
- Total distance: $28 \times 1.8 = 50.4 \geq 50$ ✓
- Time: $(28 - 1) \times 1.8 = 27 \times 1.8 = 48.6$ seconds

The minimum time across all step lengths is **48.6 seconds** (achieved with $a = 1.8$ m).

$$\boxed{48.6}$$
